author: Bijan Mousavi
title: Exact scientific preservation expectations
why: Identifiers, counts, units, relationships and attribution need source-derived expectations before application behavior changes.
what: Document exact synthetic Study/Image values, field selection, viewer and download boundaries, review roles, planned assertions and inherited missing-record behavior.
how: Trace unchanged consumers and run their actual formatting bodies with only Astro import seams replaced. Observe absent and malformed routes through the real built Node server. Verify documentation links.
preserved: Application source, data, assets, APIs, route defaults and deployment retain their bytes. Synthetic values are explicitly invented; review roles are responsibilities to confirm.
risk: Missing Study totals can collapse to zero; absent Images currently return 500. These inherited defects are characterized for separate fixes rather than approved as scientific behavior.
limitations: 90 tooling tests pass. Source checks confirm exact units and relationships. Node observations: absent Study 404, absent Images 500, malformed URI 400. Complete browser journeys, viewer decoding, galleries and Netlify runtime remain unverified.
rollback: Revert the documentation change in a reported commit; retain original application and observed characterization evidence.
